verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an MCP server whose individual users can limit a connection to selected repositories, and agents act "with your approval." That is user-level connection scoping, an adjacent control. Nothing in the evidence shows a devops lead enabling or disabling AI agents per group or instance, or setting allow/ask/deny policies per tool.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
